description: A contract of method signatures that a class implements, so callers can depend on behavior instead of one implementation.
An interface method with a body that implementing classes inherit and may override.
Calling a method through a general type while the actual object decides which implementation runs.
An interface with exactly one abstract method, which a lambda expression can implement.
A class or method with a type parameter such as T that the caller fills in and the compiler checks.
A type parameter restricted with extends so the code can use the methods of the bound.
A question mark in a type argument, such as ? extends Number, that stands for an unknown type within a limit.
The removal of type arguments after compilation, so Box of String and Box of Integer are the same class at run time.
